name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, and ZAR by carry-to-volatility ratio. Carry = short-term interbank rate minus US Fed Funds. Volatility = 63-day annualized realized vol. Output: cross-sectional ranking bar chart (current snapshot) and carry-to-vol time series (evolution).
source:
# EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking
# Carry = EM interbank rate - US Fed Funds rate
# Vol = 63-day annualized realized volatility of FX returns
# Carry-to-Vol = carry / vol — risk-adjusted carry attractiveness

# --- Data: FX prices ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Data: Interest rates (all monthly, ffilled to daily) ---
# Brazil interbank rate (SELIC proxy)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)

# Mexico 3M interbank rate (TIIE proxy)
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)

# South Africa 3M interbank rate (JIBAR proxy)
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)

# US Fed Funds rate
us_rate_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# --- Route correct EM rate to each asset ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')().result
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')().result
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')().result

# Each asset gets its own EM rate via conditional_select
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, 0.0)

# Carry = EM rate - US rate (in percentage points, e.g., 13.65 - 4.33 = 9.32pp)
carry = em_rate - us_rate

# --- Volatility: 63-day annualized realized vol ---
# basic_volatility gives daily stddev of returns (decimal fraction)
# Annualize by multiplying by sqrt(252) ≈ 15.87
daily_vol = basic_volatility(type=BasicVolatilityType.return_type, period=63)(close)
ann_vol = daily_vol.result * sqrt(252)

# Convert annualized vol to percentage points to match carry units
# ann_vol is decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%), carry is in pp (e.g., 9.32)
ann_vol_pct = ann_vol * 100.0

# --- Carry-to-Vol ratio ---
# Guard against division by zero
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(ann_vol_pct) and ann_vol_pct > 0, carry / ann_vol_pct)

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- Output 1: Carry-to-Vol time series (CONTEXT — how has ranking evolved?) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Which EM Currency Offers the Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='EM FX Carry-to-Vol',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Teal],
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 2: Current ranking bar chart (PUNCHLINE — who ranks highest now?) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Teal],
    category='EM FX Carry-to-Vol',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Event markers for ranking changes (when top carry currency flips) ---
# Detect when each currency becomes the top-ranked carry-to-vol
is_top_carry = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=1)(carry_to_vol)

# Mark when a new currency takes the #1 spot
new_top = is_top_carry and not (is_top_carry >> 1)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New Top Carry Currency',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry-to-Vol', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry (pp)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Vol (%)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry_to_vol, carry, ann_vol_pct, new_top)
